[AMD] Fix CodeGen build for LLVM @293a85c0 (#12660)

The AMD codegen LLVM pin moved to llvm/llvm-project@293a85c048f7, where
ScopedNoAliasAAResult no longer has a default constructor and instead
takes the LLVMContext it reads analysis options from. Pass the
function's context when DAGBuilder sets up alias analysis.

Also drop the alias-scope domain downgrade applied when serializing IR
for the codegen library. It was added while that library was pinned to
an LLVM that predated disjoint alias scopes; both the current pin
(08b05a3352ee) and the new one (293a85c048f7) accept the new domain
format, so the downgrade only discarded the disjoint guarantee.

files.patch:
@@ -111,11 +111,9 @@ def get_amd_codegen_revision() -> str:
 
 
 def _serialize_for_amd_codegen(src: str, enable_fp_fusion: bool) -> bytes:
-    # Serialize with Triton's LLVM, adapting alias-scope domains to the format
-    # supported by the independently pinned AMD code generator.
     # Express fusion permission in the IR because newer LLVM versions no
     # longer honor TargetOptions::AllowFPOpFusion during code generation.
-    return llvm.to_bitcode(src, enable_fp_fusion, legacy_alias_scopes=True)
+    return llvm.to_bitcode(src, enable_fp_fusion)
 
 
 def _codegen_options(triple: str, processor: str, features: str, *, flags: list[str], enable_fp_fusion: bool,

[AMD] Build LLVM @293a85c048f7 for CodeGen (#12656)

Bump the AMD codegen LLVM build pin to
`llvm/llvm-project@293a85c048f754b849829c7920846e4fbe5ab980`, the commit
for https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/220442 ("[AMDGPU]
Implement AsyncMark Stages", merged 2026-11-06).

That change gives `llvm.amdgcn.asyncmark` / `llvm.amdgcn.wait.asyncmark`
a constant stage-mask operand and per-stage `SIInsertWaitcnts` scoring.

[AMD] UpdateAsyncWaitCount: walk past region ops without async ops (#12629)

computeMinCountBackward fell back to a wait count of 0 at every op with
regions except tt.reduce. Ops such as tt.map_elementwise cannot issue
async copies, yet a Gluon kernel that rescales its accumulator through
tt.map_elementwise between issuing TDM copies and waiting on them got
s_wait_tensorcnt 0 and lost its prefetch.

Fall back only if the op's regions contain an async op or a commit
group; any other region op, tt.reduce included, is walked past like a
plain op.

@@ -720,3 +720,59 @@ module attributes {"ttg.num-ctas" = 1 : i32, "ttg.num-warps" = 4 : i32, ttg.targ
     tt.return
   }
 }
+
+// -----
+
+// An op with a region that issues no async ops (here tt.map_elementwise) does
+// not change the outstanding count: the walk continues past it instead of
+// falling back to a conservative count of 0.
+
+#blocked = #ttg.blocked<{sizePerThread = [1], threadsPerWarp = [32], warpsPerCTA = [4], order = [0]}>
+#shared = #ttg.swizzled_shared<{vec = 1, perPhase = 1, maxPhase = 1, order = [1, 0]}>
+#smem = #ttg.shared_memory
+module attributes {"ttg.num-ctas" = 1 : i32, "ttg.num-warps" = 4 : i32, ttg.target = "hip:gfx1250", "ttg.threads-per-warp" = 32 : i32} {
+  // CHECK-LABEL: tdm_waitcnt_across_region_without_async_ops
+  tt.func public @tdm_waitcnt_across_region_without_async_ops(%memDesc: !ttg.memdesc<128x16xf16, #shared, #smem, mutable>, %tensorDesc: !tt.tensordesc<128x16xf16>, %x: tensor<128xf32, #blocked>) -> tensor<128xf32, #blocked> {
+    %1 = amdg.async_tdm_copy_global_to_local %tensorDesc into %memDesc : !tt.tensordesc<128x16xf16> -> !ttg.memdesc<128x16xf16, #shared, #smem, mutable>
+    %2 = amdg.async_tdm_copy_global_to_local %tensorDesc into %memDesc : !tt.tensordesc<128x16xf16> -> !ttg.memdesc<128x16xf16, #shared, #smem, mutable>
+    %y = "tt.map_elementwise"(%x) <{pack = 1 : i32}> ({
+    ^bb0(%a: f32):
+      %sq = arith.mulf %a, %a : f32
+      tt.map_elementwise.return %sq : f32
+    }) : (tensor<128xf32, #blocked>) -> tensor<128xf32, #blocked>
+    // Wait without a token, as Gluon emits it: one TDM op may stay outstanding
+    // => waitcnt 1
+    // CHECK: amdg.async_tdm_intrinsic_wait {count = 1
+    %w = amdg.async_tdm_wait {num = 1 : i32}
+    tt.return %y : tensor<128xf32, #blocked>
+  }
+}
+
+// -----
+
+// A TDM wait counts only TDM ops, so an async commit group nested in a region
+// op the walk does not analyze (here scf.index_switch) does not change the
+// outstanding count: the walk continues past it instead of falling back to a
+// conservative count of 0.
+
+#shared = #ttg.swizzled_shared<{vec = 1, perPhase = 1, maxPhase = 1, order = [1, 0]}>
+#smem = #ttg.shared_memory
+module attributes {"ttg.num-ctas" = 1 : i32, "ttg.num-warps" = 4 : i32, ttg.target = "hip:gfx1250", "ttg.threads-per-warp" = 32 : i32} {
+  // CHECK-LABEL: tdm_waitcnt_across_region_with_commit_group
+  tt.func public @tdm_waitcnt_across_region_with_commit_group(%memDesc: !ttg.memdesc<128x16xf16, #shared, #smem, mutable>, %tensorDesc: !tt.tensordesc<128x16xf16>, %idx: index) {
+    %1 = amdg.async_tdm_copy_global_to_local %tensorDesc into %memDesc : !tt.tensordesc<128x16xf16> -> !ttg.memdesc<128x16xf16, #shared, #smem, mutable>
+    %2 = amdg.async_tdm_copy_global_to_local %tensorDesc into %memDesc : !tt.tensordesc<128x16xf16> -> !ttg.memdesc<128x16xf16, #shared, #smem, mutable>
+    scf.index_switch %idx
+    case 0 {
+      %c = ttg.async_commit_group
+      scf.yield
+    }
+    default {
+      scf.yield
+    }
+    // One TDM op may stay outstanding => waitcnt 1
+    // CHECK: amdg.async_tdm_intrinsic_wait {count = 1
+    %w = amdg.async_tdm_wait {num = 1 : i32}
+    tt.return
+  }
+}

[AMD][gfx9] Fix small K in MFMA  (#12630)

Follow the fix like WMMA side for MFMA as well, use zero padding when
the tensor K dim is smaller than instruction K dim.

---------

Signed-off-by: Pengzhan Zhao <borontion@gmail.com>
